project-show.help: One project's registration, observation, and the non-archived tasks that branch from it; writes nothing

project-migrate.help: Inspect what still references a legacy/external clone and print guidance; --apply renames it to the canonical path only when zero references are proven (coordinator only)

arguments.name: --apply
arguments.help: Perform the rename after a clean inspection; refused while any task, linked worktree, or process references the clone

graph-init.help: Coordinator only: initialize or reconcile the task checkout's index (bounded retries; exhausted stays recorded)

graph-status.help: Recorded graph state plus one live freshness observation; writes nothing

graph-config.help: Print an MCP snippet naming the pinned binary for one harness; no file is written

arguments.name: --raw
arguments.help: Print only the snippet text

dev-prepare.help: Create or reopen .sum/dev/NAME on branch sum-dev/NAME; optionally open an ordinary Herdr pane there

arguments.name: --pane
arguments.help: Also create a Herdr workspace whose root pane starts in the checkout

dev-remove.help: Remove a clean development checkout with plain git worktree remove; dirty work is preserved

brief-list.help: Show recorded revisions, their integrity, and refresh state

brief-regenerate.help: Stage a new numbered revision from the approved task, current decisions, and current policy (coordinator only)

brief-request.help: Mark the latest intact revision as requested for the worker (coordinator only); sends nothing

brief-adopt.help: Worker: record that the requested revision is now the brief being followed

refresh-request.help: Coordinator only: regenerate and request revisions for the coordinator and/or tasks, persist, then try one delivery each

arguments.name: --task
arguments.help: Refresh only this task (repeatable)

arguments.name: --coordinator
arguments.help: Refresh only the coordinator's operating contract

refresh-status.help: Bounded refresh summary from saved records; writes nothing

refresh-adopt.help: Coordinator: record the receipt of the requested contract revision

release-stage.help: Stage the runtime bundle for a commit (default HEAD) with its own dependencies; nothing live changes

update-check.help: Fetch origin, resolve the merged revision, and report compatibility; changes no selection

arguments.name: --ref
arguments.help: A revision merged on origin's default branch; default: that branch tip

arguments.name: --no-fetch
arguments.help: Use the already fetched origin refs (offline host)

update-stage.help: Check plus build the release bundle; the default is unchanged

arguments.name: --ref
arguments.help: A revision merged on origin's default branch; default: that branch tip

arguments.name: --no-fetch
arguments.help: Use the already fetched origin refs (offline host)

update-apply.help: Stage if needed, validate coexistence under the activation lock, then switch the default in one rename (coordinator only)

arguments.name: --ref
arguments.help: A revision merged on origin's default branch; default: that branch tip

arguments.name: --no-fetch
arguments.help: Use the already fetched origin refs (offline host)

update-status.help: Default and active runtime, checkout state, staged releases, recent selections; writes nothing

update-rollback.help: Atomically select the previous runtime (or --to SHA|checkout) after compatibility checks; records are never touched (coordinator only)

update-recover.help: Complete generation-checked compensation for an interrupted activation (coordinator only)
